blocks.text: Setting up your curriculum workspace in Notion

Start by creating a master database for your curriculum units. Use the /database command to initialize a new table. This keeps your planning organized. You can add columns for status, grade level, and subject. This structure helps you filter content quickly when you have dozens of units in progress.

Your Mac is a powerful tool for curriculum design. Keep the Notion desktop app updated to ensure you have the latest features. Use ⌘ P to open the search bar. This is the fastest way to jump between lesson modules. If you get stuck on a complex page, ask Lazur to walk you through it.
Managing lesson plans with Notion databases

Create a template for your lesson plans. Include sections for learning objectives, materials, and assessment criteria. Apply this template to every new entry in your database. This consistency makes it easier to export your work or share it with teachers later. Use the /template command to set this up.

items: Use properties to link your lesson plans to specific state standards.
Create a board view to track the status of curriculum development from draft to review.
Add a formula property to calculate total instructional hours per unit.
Use toggles to hide detailed teacher notes while keeping the page clean.
Lock your database pages to prevent accidental edits to core content.

blocks.text: Lazur lives in the notch of your Mac. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask questions about your Notion workspace. If you forget where a specific setting is, ask Lazur to point it out. It will circle the element on your screen. This saves you from hunting through menus.

Curriculum documents often span dozens of pages. Use the table of contents block to make navigation easier. Type /toc to insert it at the top of your document. This is especially useful for long unit guides. If you are drafting text, hold fn to dictate your thoughts directly into the block.

items: Avoid creating too many top-level pages. Use sub-pages to keep your sidebar tidy.
Do not ignore the database filters. They are your best tool for finding specific content.
Remember to check for updates in the Notion menu to keep your app running smoothly.
Do not rely solely on manual entry for repetitive tasks. Use templates instead.

blocks.text: If you find yourself repeating the same steps, use the keyboard shortcuts. Press Shift + ? to see the full list of available hotkeys. Mastering these can save you hours of work each week.

faq.question: Can I use Notion for curriculum development on older Macs?
faq.answer: Notion requires macOS 13 or later. Check your system settings to ensure your Mac meets the requirements.

faq.question: How does Lazur assist with Notion?
faq.answer: Lazur helps you navigate Notion faster by pointing at buttons, answering questions about features, and dictating text directly into your pages.

faq.question: Is there a limit to how many blocks I can use in Notion?
faq.answer: The 1,000-block limit only applies to workspaces with two or more members. Solo workspaces do not have this limit.
